# 7-Zip

Earlier RedMagicEMU builds bundled the static `7zzs` from `7z2604-linux-arm64.tar.xz` as `lib/arm64-v8a/libsevenzip.so`. The binary was removed in `212a04a`. [7-Zip 26.04](https://github.com/ip7z/7zip)

The original license text includes the LGPL terms and the unRAR restriction. [License](License.txt)
